key_idea: Only red dots on Mia's road count, and she passes each one once.
steps: Mia drives along the top, down the right side and along the bottom to Y.
On the top road there are 3 red dots. On the right side there are 2. On the bottom road there are 2.
The other 3 red dots are at the far ends of side roads, so Mia never drives over them.
